applied.problem: "Pieces finer than twelfths keep working" is false in general: fifths, sixths, tenths and any piece 4 does not go into leave 3/4 with no whole count; only finer pieces both bottoms go into work.

Two over-general claims: "not four of anything" is literally false (any amount is four of its own quarter), and "the piece should not change at all" contradicts the lesson, which changes the half into quarters; the piece that must not change is the matched one.
